Hi Mina —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Quick answers from our side:

- Priorities (must-have): SOC 2 type II report (most recent), incident response playbook excerpts that show escalation and customer notification steps, and a sample breach notification template we can map to our legal requirements.
- Nice-to-have: DR test reports, architecture diagram showing separation between customer data and telemetry, and any KMS/HSM integration details.

Procurement timeline: we are aiming to collect initial evidence by Dec 10 so legal/procurement can do a preliminary assessment before our December 17 security steering committee. 5 business days would be tight but workable for the must-have set. Can you commit to sending the must-have artifacts by Dec 1 EOD? If so, we’ll start our review and let you know if additional items are required.

Also, for HIPAA-specific items: we will need to see your standard BA agreement language or an outline of controls you map to HIPAA privacy/security rules. If you can flag any parts of your IR playbook that are HIPAA-specific, that will speed review.

Thanks — I’ve looped our security inbox and you should expect follow-ups on the questionnaire.

Best,

Hi Ellen —

Attaching the timeline snippet I mentioned in the demo. Summary below for your security steering committee:

- Detection to internal triage: target <= 1 hour from reliable alerting
- Internal triage to containment decision: target <= 6 hours
- Customer notification (edge of impact, PII/HIPAA/PHI confirmed): target <= 72 hours from confirmation of breach scope; for GDPR we align with 72-hour regulator notification window and will notify customers using the template attached.
- Public disclosure: coordinated with legal; target depends on regulator guidance and materiality but we aim for coordinated messaging within 5 business days of customer notification.

We will prepare: non-redacted IR runbook under NDA, SOC 2 Type II under NDA, HIPAA mapping document, and a short DR test summary. Given your Dec 10 internal cutoff, our team will stage must-have artifacts in a secure bucket and share upload details by EOD Dec 1 if you confirm NDA route.
